sources.citation: OLAC, 'Resources in and about the Mekmek language' [mvk] (Wayback 2024 capture of language-archives.org/language/mvk)
sources.note: Complete inventory: PARADISEC JM1-08, JM1-18, JM1-19 (McElvenny 2005-06 audio, Fundukua and Mansuat dialects), PARADISEC DL2-033 (Laycock Notebook D22), Glottolog, Ethnologue, LINGUIST List. No language description exists.

Reports Foley (2018: 226) that 'Changriwa and Mekmek are attested only by short words [wordlists], and are tentatively grouped as separate branches... due to scanty evidence'; no phonology for Mekmek, nothing on stress.
